label: Time frames as probabilities
subgoals: Compute each operation's time frame under the latency bound
Assign probability one over the frame width inside the frame
Assign probability zero outside the frame

label: Distribution graphs
subgoals: Group the operations by unit type
Sum their probabilities at each step
Read peaks as steps that will demand extra units

label: Self-force and the iteration
subgoals: Compute the distribution value at the candidate step
Subtract the frame average of the distribution graph
Fix the lowest-force operation and recompute the frames
